events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.93)
events.body:
NS-0 routes this case: cancelled_by = driver and the driver claims rider no-show, so it is governed by NS-1/NS-2 [F4][F12][NS-0]. NS-1 requires all three of (i) an arrival confirmation (driver tap or platform auto), (ii) GPS at the pickup at that moment, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of continuous waiting inside the radius after the confirmation, before the $6.61 can stand [F6][F5][NS-1].

Element (i) fails outright: the record shows no "I'm Here" tap and no platform auto-arrival (driver_pressed_here_at is null) [F6]. The driver himself admits he forgot to press the button [F12]. Elements (ii) and (iii) therefore have no reference moment and cannot be established: the 5 min 20 s cumulative time within 200 m runs from first entering the radius at 22:41:30 [F2], and the 4 min 0 s stationary period runs 22:42:50–22:46:50 [F3] — neither is measured after an arrival confirmation, and NS-1 expressly excludes pre-tap time in the vicinity [F5][NS-1]. A driver's post-hoc statement that he was physically there is a claim, not a substitute for the required confirmation [F12][NS-1].

Because NS-1 (i) (and consequently (ii) and (iii)) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full, i.e. refund_full of $6.61, matching the fee on record [F7][F4][NS-2]. NS-2's extra flag_account attaches only where the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius (m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200); here there was no confirmation at all and the closest approach was 34 m, so no fraud flag arises [F1][F6][NS-2]. The trace's own note confirms this: flag_account required False [F6][F1].

The traffic record is irrelevant to a no-show case — no incidents near the route [F14], and a moderate speed band on Woodlands Avenue 5 does not bear on the cancellation conditions [F13][NS-1]. The chat is consistent with the driver having been nearby, but agreeing on location is not the same as the confirmation the policy requires [F9][F10][F11][NS-1]. Profile facts (long-standing accounts, no prior upheld disputes on either side) play no part in deciding the case and are not cited as a basis [F16][F17][NS-1].

Your account isn't flagged, but please always confirm your arrival at the pickup point before cancelling for a no-show.
